acceptance_meaning: One bounded implementation amendment is scientifically interpretable; static review found no fatal blocker. This is source review, not activation or a quality result.
scope: Compared all differences in deployment.py, worker.py and verify.py to preserved v1; training.py and controller.py are byte-identical.

Standard low-memory GPU from_pretrained base-weight I/O replaces discarded GPU random initialization. Physical deletion and strict sealed-state override preserve complete tensor digest/layout, aliases and SDPA. Receipt accurately discloses base-weight I/O.

Before adapter construction, both corrected arms compare all buffers including FP32 nonpersistent RoPE, frozen graph, functional configuration (excluding only _name_or_path) and generation configuration to the preserved first CE initialization/metadata; adapter initialization now follows a fresh seed42 reset. Existing pre-training reset is retained.
Original CE is excluded from the valid comparison; no old learned checkpoint is used for new training. Fixed data, deletion, adapter coordinates, optimizer, loss and update count remain unchanged.

Original first CE/KD absolute deadlines are used for alarm remaining time and verified against actual exits; earlier costs are included within the cumulative 3900-model-second bound. Repair waiting reduces remaining old phase time.
FIRST_ATTEMPT records prior CE320 QA/20 updates and KD0 QA/0 teacher requests, zero new quality; successful corrected pair would total960 backwards/60 updates including the discarded arm.
required_frozen_inputs: Bind FIRST_ATTEMPT.json, FIRST_MODEL_METADATA.json and first_CE_INITIALIZATION.json in the new READY prior_files, alongside preserved first-attempt provenance. Their values define the amendment; this review does not authorize mutable replacement.
limitations: Acceptance explicitly amends the protocol authored first-failure/no-automatic-version rule once; it does not erase the original failure or claim the prior protocol was followed unchanged.
Review discloses authorship of original deployment.py; this is not independent certification of that entire helper. Root and research_review independently reviewed the original deployment source.
No model, QA, CUDA operator, server action, rescoring or checkpoint rehash was executed by this review; standard-library AST and small-file comparisons only.
